description: Labeled evaluation set for the Contract Risk Reviewer. Each item is a contract snippet with the set of risk categories a reviewer should flag (ground truth). Used by run_eval.py to measure per-category detection rate (recall) and false-positive rate on clean clauses.

contracts.text: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless either party gives written notice at least 90 days before expiration.
The Contractor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited and the Contractor shall be liable for all damages, whether direct or indirect.
Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Company from any and all third-party claims arising from the services.
The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time for convenience without cause upon thirty days written notice.
All work product created hereunder is a work made for hire and Contractor hereby assigns all right, title and interest in it to the Client.
For two years following termination, Consultant shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that competes with the Client.
Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days. Client reserves the right to change the rates upon notice.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of its courts.
The receiving party's confidentiality obligations shall survive indefinitely and remain in perpetuity.
The software is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind, and the vendor disclaims all warranties, express or implied.

This Agreement automatically renews for additional one-year terms. Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client. Contractor's liability is unlimited. The Client may terminate for convenience at any time.
All intellectual property shall be assigned to the Company as a work for hire. Consultant shall not compete with the Company for a period of three years. Payment terms are net 90.
The parties shall cooperate in good faith. This Agreement may be amended only by a written instrument signed by both parties. Notices shall be sent to the addresses set forth above.
Each party shall bear its own costs. The services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.
This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions. Headings are for convenience only.
